subject: Inbound: GitHub integration & demo — timezone + permissions questions
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@glowcode.dev>
To: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood — GitHub integration + quick demo

Hi Rachel,

I signed up for Redwood this morning (self-serve) and poked around the GitHub connector docs — looks promising. I’m Alex, maintain infra at GlowCode (we run several public repos and a small CI infra team). I’m hoping to see a short walkthrough focused on: webhook setup, repo-level vs org-level permissions, and best practices for CI caching with Redwood.

Quick context: we want to evaluate for repo automation across ~10 org repos, mostly public but a handful private. We may need org-level webhooks if that’s supported.

Do you have availability for a 30-minute call this week? Our TZ is PST. If it helps, here’s a sample repo: https://github.com/glowcode/cli-plugin — it’s public.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Morgan
Infra Lead, GlowCode
alex.morgan@glowcode.dev

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@glowcode.dev>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — GitHub integration + quick demo

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the repo link. Rachel is our AE for integrations and I looped her in. Quick availability from our side (PST):
- Tue 8/24: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 8/25: 09:30–11:00

If none of those work, drop a preferred slot and we’ll accommodate. Also, do you plan to include anyone from your security/infra team on the intro call? It’s helpful for the permissions discussion.

I’ll send a Calendly link, but feel free to reply with a time.

—Ben
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@glowcode.dev>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 17:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — GitHub integration + quick demo

Hi Alex — really glad you found the docs and thanks for the sample repo. A couple of quick clarifying points before we lock time so we tailor the demo: 

- Permissions: do you prefer org-level installation (single app install across org) or installing per-repo? Org-level gives easier on-boarding for many repos but requires org admin consent.
- Private repos: you mentioned a few private repos — can you confirm how many and whether they require SSO-restricted access?
- CI caching: are you currently using any remote cache (e.g., buildkite cache, s3) or local artifact stores? That helps us prepare a short config snippet.

I opened two slots that match Ben’s suggested windows: Tue 8/24 10:30–11:00 PST and Wed 8/25 09:30–10:00 PST. Please pick one or propose another. If you have a colleague who owns GitHub admin or CI, please CC them — we’ll include a short checklist for org install.

I also attached a one-page PDF that outlines the permission levels and a quick screenshot of our repo settings UI to show where the webhook/installation flows live.

Attachments:
- glowcode-org-perms.pdf (perm table + checklist)
- repo-shot.png (screenshot of Redwood repo configuration)

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Integrations
Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@glowcode.dev>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kothari <priya.k@glowcode.dev>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — GitHub integration & demo — timezone + permissions questions

Thanks Rachel — Wed 8/25 09:30 PST works for us. I’ve added Priya (our CI owner) to the thread. We’ll join from Zoom — please include a calendar invite.

Quick answers to your clarifying Qs:
- Org-level install: yes, we’re comfortable with org-level if we can scope to specific repositories.
- Private repos: 3 private repos, behind SSO — Priya will confirm whether any additional approval is needed.
- CI cache: we currently push to an s3-backed remote cache. We’d love to see config best practices for that.

I reviewed the PDF — super helpful. I attached a small screenshot of our repo settings where the current webhooks live (repo-shot.png).

See you Wed — Alex
Alex Morgan
Infra Lead, GlowCode
